name: Metal Storm
main_effect:
When you would use this card, if you have a Digimon with [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards, reduce the memory cost of this card by 2.
[Main] Return 1 of your opponent's level 6 or lower Digimon to its owner's hand. Then, unsuspend 1 of your Digimon with [Garurumon] in its name.
